name: Frame of reference, tangential and blocking transactions
oneLine: Everyone filters reality through their own frame of reference; tangential and blocking transactions are the two concrete moves people use, outside awareness, to defend it when it feels threatened.
whatYouDid: You caught Arjun answering about Monday when Priya asked about today - a tangential transaction that still sounded like a real answer.
confusion: Tangential and blocking transactions look like real answers or real questions; the tell is that the original issue never actually gets addressed.

fromBook.quote: the structure of associated responses which integrates the various ego-states in response to specific stimuli.

expand.definition: A tangential transaction answers from a different angle or time frame than the one addressed; a blocking transaction avoids the issue by disputing the definition of the issue itself - both are redefining in action, a defense of the frame of reference against a perceived threat.
expand.otherFraming: The script itself is just the part of someone's frame of reference that happens to contain discounts - so every redefining transaction you spot is also a live discount you can trace back through the Discount Matrix.
expand.tryThisToday: Next time a conversation feels like it's going nowhere or going in circles, check whether someone, possibly you, just drifted onto a related topic or started arguing a definition instead of answering the actual question.
